confirmed_task: Find technical specs for the latest MacBook Air on Apple.

items.criterion: Navigate to Apple to access the latest MacBook Air product page/specifications
items.description: Use Apple as the source (e.g., Apple MacBook Air product page and/or Apple Tech Specs page) to locate information about the latest MacBook Air. Full credit if Apple pages are accessed and clearly correspond to the latest MacBook Air model available at the time. Full credit also if the Apple site is inaccessible (down, region block, CAPTCHA, requires unsupported interaction) and the agent reports the blocker and uses a reasonable Apple-owned alternative source (e.g., Apple Support tech specs / Apple Support articles) or clearly explains the inability to verify on Apple due to the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses non-Apple sources without first attempting Apple or without explaining why Apple could not be used. No credit if the agent relies on unrelated/non-authoritative sources while Apple is accessible.

items.criterion: Identify which model is the 'latest MacBook Air' per Apple
items.description: Correctly determine and state which MacBook Air model/configuration Apple currently presents as the latest (e.g., chip generation and available sizes) based on Apple’s current listings. Full credit if the identified model is consistent with Apple’s current lineup OR if Apple pages cannot be accessed and the agent clearly states that it cannot be verified directly on Apple due to the reported blocker, while using an Apple-owned alternative source (e.g., Apple Support tech specs) to justify the best-available determination. Partial credit if the agent identifies a plausible recent model but does not clearly justify it as the latest per Apple (e.g., ambiguous evidence) or if region-specific differences are not acknowledged when apparent. No credit if the agent clearly identifies an older/discontinued model as the latest when the currently accessible Apple lineup indicates otherwise, or if it asserts a latest model without any Apple-based support when Apple is accessible.

items.criterion: Provide technical specs for the latest MacBook Air from Apple
items.description: Extract and report technical specifications from Apple for the latest MacBook Air (as identified). Full credit if the agent provides a substantive set of technical specs (not just marketing claims) drawn from Apple’s product/spec or Tech Specs content and clearly ties them to the identified latest model; OR, if Apple specs pages are inaccessible, the agent reports the blocker and provides specs from an Apple-owned alternative (e.g., Apple Support tech specs) and/or clearly states which specs could not be confirmed due to the access limitation. Partial credit if only a smaller subset of specs is provided but is correct and Apple-sourced, or if some specs are missing/unclear due to page limitations while the attempt is evident. No credit if specs are largely incorrect, not tied to the claimed latest model, or appear fabricated (no Apple-based support) when Apple information is accessible.
